tools.name: render_og_image
tools.description: Build a 1200x630 Open Graph PNG. Supports title, subtitle, badge, theme, logo_url (https), and hex colors bg/fg/accent. Free light use is watermarked and capped per site (10/day). Production: POST https://ogstamp.com/api/og with Bearer ogs_…. Add store=1&format=json to get a stable hosted https://og

tools.name: og_image_from_url
tools.description: Build an Open Graph card for an existing public page with no fields to fill in: OG Stamp fetches the page and uses its title, description, favicon and theme-color. Returns a stable image URL you can paste straight into og:image. Any field can be overridden.

tools.name: og_pricing
tools.description: Return OG Stamp credit packs. Credits never expire. PayPal one-time, not a subscription.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "render_og_image" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Build a 1200x630 Open Graph PNG. Supports title, subtitle, badge, theme, logo_url (https), and hex colors bg/fg/accent. Free light use is watermarked and capped…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_og_image, og_image_from_url · Public sink: render_og_image · Destructive: render_og_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_og_image, og_image_from_url · Public sink: render_og_image · Destructive: render_og_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
